decision: Go for native-first on hosts satisfying the documented evidence capability contract

requirements.evidence: formal SKILL.md equals frozen tested candidate; optional helper compatibility native-results.json
plan snapshots, four session IDs, seven terminal turns; 6.1 plan-only prior diagnostic snapshot

requirements.requirement: individual checks and stable source endpoints
requirements.evidence: functional-audit.json; six check receipts; full native calls/results

requirements.requirement: misleading PASS must fail; negative assessment can complete
requirements.evidence: two initial exit7 native results, initial trackers done/subject FAIL

requirements.requirement: stale evidence not reused; unknown not replayed
requirements.evidence: source-change records, both resume command lists and final trackers; preserved receipt hashes

requirements.requirement: missing evidence cannot become acceptance; safe independent work can continue
requirements.evidence: current-version acceptance verifying/blocked, independent T3 assessment done; no separate tool-less-host test
61 and 56 native tool evidence; reviewed individual successful writes before subsequent dispatch or successor product action
receipt fields and native tracker transitions; distinct new resume receipts; all old receipts unchanged

requirements.requirement: Core-only installation does not require helper
requirements.evidence: both execution skill copies omit scripts/run_check.py; completed products/evidence without external language process

requirements.requirement: static skill and named research validation
requirements.evidence: final-validators.json; validators do not substitute for behavior

requirements.requirement: docs current and unrelated contents preserved
requirements.evidence: updated spec and functional research report; README/hooks/UI/helper hashes preserved

requirements.requirement: finite scope, no extra candidate or retry-for-green
requirements.evidence: four existing-planned coordinators, four workers, one frozen candidate; no new round

limitations: shared host, not blind or causal comparison
no all-platform or entirely tool-less host certification
CRC and ordinary writes do not imply tamper resistance or atomic reservation
historical handoff and low backlog are not automatically closed
